identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Govern configuration-generation handoff across CSM, Guardian, and kernel

values.review_scope: Issue #686 configuration-generation receipt, atomic activation, propagation, fail-closed compatibility, and isolated recovery proof only.
review_prompts: Can any partial candidate or mutable file become authority without a committed receipt?
Do CSM Guardian kernel status and readiness prove identical generation and digest?
Can a secret value enter any durable or observable surface?
Does every named failpoint recover deterministically to either the candidate commit or prior generation?
Does validation avoid the live Runtime?
